sell.not_found: This listing was not found, or it is not yours.
sell.verify: Only members with a verified identity and e-mail can sell.
sell.changed: This listing has changed and can no longer be edited this way.
sell.prohibited_policy: Some kinds of item cannot be sold on TrustBazaar; they are shown but cannot be chosen.
sell.field.title: Title
sell.description_hint: At least 20 characters. Describe the item honestly, including any faults.
sell.no_defects: The item has no visible defects
sell.defects_hint: If it has visible defects, at least one photo must show them.
sell.commission: TrustBazaar's commission of {percent}% of the item price is deducted from your payout.
sell.commission_fixed: TrustBazaar's commission of {percent}% ({amount} for each one sold) is deducted from your payout.
sell.area_hint: Buyers see only the district; the area is used for distance.
sell.location_unavailable: Your location could not be found. Choose your area from the list.
sell.need.title: Enter a title of at least 5 characters.
sell.need.description: Enter a description of at least 20 characters.
sell.need.parcel: For courier delivery choose the weight and size.
sell.need.price: Enter the price in taka, for example 1500.
sell.need.start_price: Enter the starting price in taka.
sell.need.reserve: Enter the reserve price in taka, or leave it empty.
sell.reserve_below: The reserve price cannot be below the starting price.
sell.error.item-kind: not for this kind of item
sell.error.one-of-cp-07: choose one of the durations offered
sell.error.defect-photo-needed: a photo must show the defects
sell.error.defect-photo-or-declaration: show the defects in a photo, or declare there are none
sell.error.auction-sets-start-price-at-p: an auction's price is its starting price, given when publishing
sell.photos_hint: At least {min} and at most {max} photos; JPEG, PNG or WebP. The first is the main photo.
sell.these_show_defects: The photos I add now show the defects
sell.photos_refused: These photos could not be used: {names}. Use JPEG, PNG or WebP images within the size limit.
sell.reserve_hint: Below the reserve the item is not sold. Bidders see only that there is a reserve.
sell.commission_payout: When it sells, TrustBazaar's commission of {percent}% of the item price is deducted from your payout.
sell.fixed_after_publish: After the first order, only clarifications can be added to the description.
sell.fixed_after_publish_auction: The starting price, reserve and duration never change after publishing; after that only clarifications can be added.
sell.published: Published. Buyers can see it now.
sell.sent_to_review: Sent to review. TrustBazaar's staff will check it before buyers can see it.
sell.in_review: This listing is waiting for review. Buyers will see it once TrustBazaar's staff have checked it.
sell.limit_reached: You have reached the number of active listings your account allows.
sell.locked_note: This listing has a bid or an order, so it can no longer be edited. You can add clarifications.
sell.clarifications_hint: Shown below the description with the date; they cannot be removed.
sell.game.kind_hint: A game account sells once. Its listing is reviewed with a proof that you own it before buyers see it. You never type login details here; they are sealed in your browser after payment.
sell.game.in_review: Your listing is waiting for review. Send the ownership proof below; buyers see it once it is approved.
sell.game.title: The game account
sell.game.no_logins: Never write the password, recovery e-mail or any login detail in the listing.
sell.game.player_id_hint: The ID other players see in the game, not a login.
sell.game.player_id_fixed: The player ID cannot change once the ownership proof is sent.
sell.game.contents_hint: What the account holds: level, items, characters, purchases.
sell.game.need.player_id: Give the player ID (at least 2 characters).
sell.game.need.contents: Describe what the account holds (at least 10 characters).
sell.game.details_first: Save the game details before publishing.
sell.game.review_first: A game account is held for review when published; you then send the ownership proof.
sell.game.proof_title: Proof that you own the account
sell.game.proof_hint: Get a one-time code, put it in the game where it says, then upload a screenshot that shows the code and the player ID.
sell.game.proof.expired: The code has expired. Ask for a new one.
sell.game.upload: Upload the screenshot (JPEG, PNG or WebP)
sell.error.fixed-after-proof: fixed once the proof is sent
sell.error.type: use a JPEG, PNG or WebP image
sell.error.code-expired: the code has expired; ask for a new one
sell.steps.label: Steps
